name: Velachery Vijayanagar Junction
primary_vulnerability_cause: Low-lying basin surrounded by urban development; runoff bottleneck into Pallikaranai marshland with flat discharge gradient.
source_reference: Greater Chennai Corporation (GCC) Chronic Waterlogging Hotspots Registry / TNSDMA

name: Madipakkam (Ram Nagar / Kuberan Nagar)
primary_vulnerability_cause: Reclaimed agricultural/lake bed adjacent to Pallikaranai wetland; lacks natural gravitational storm runoff outfall.
source_reference: GCC Flood Mitigation Master Plan / CMWSSB Basin Studies

name: Mudichur (Varadharajapuram / Mudichur Road)
primary_vulnerability_cause: Direct floodplain of Adyar river tributary and surplus overflow channels from Chembarambakkam catchment basin.
source_reference: State Disaster Management Authority (TNSDMA) & CWC Adyar Basin Reports

name: T. Nagar (Usman Road / Bazullah Road / GN Chetty)
primary_vulnerability_cause: Extremely high surface imperviousness (near 90%); micro-drain overflow into silted Mambalam Canal causing reverse urban backflow.
source_reference: Chennai Smart City Mission / GCC Stormwater Audit

name: Pulianthope (Dr. Ambedkar College Road / Demellows Road)
primary_vulnerability_cause: North Chennai low-elevation bowl adjacent to Buckingham Canal; historical stagnation zone affected by high tide backflow.
source_reference: GCC North Chennai Flood Audits & Health Dept Vector Control Records

name: Vyasarpadi (Ganesapuram Subway / Jeeva Railway Station)
primary_vulnerability_cause: Sub-grade depression subway receiving stormwater from surrounding road networks; pump failure rapidly submerges subway.
source_reference: Greater Chennai Traffic Police Advisory Records & GCC Subway Pump Station Logs

name: Perambur (Stephenson Road Subway / Otteri Nullah)
primary_vulnerability_cause: Otteri Nullah canal banks overflow into adjacent low-lying roads and railway underpasses.
source_reference: GCC Monsoon Action Plan / PWD Water Resources Department Records

name: Koyambedu (SAF Games Village / Wholesale Market / PH Road)
primary_vulnerability_cause: Cooum River high water levels prevent storm drain discharge; massive surface runoff from market and bus terminal pavement.
source_reference: Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority (CMDA) / GCC Zone 8 Logs

name: Manapakkam (MIOT Hospital / Mount-Poonamallee Road)
primary_vulnerability_cause: Major sharp bend and narrowing in the Adyar River corridor; river water breaches embankments into hospitals and arterial roads.
source_reference: TNSDMA Disaster Review 2015 & 2023 / CWC Flood Gauging Station Manapakkam

name: Pallikaranai (Kamakshi Hospital / Velachery-Tambaram Road)
primary_vulnerability_cause: Central drainage sink for South Chennai; culvert capacity along 200 Feet Radial Road is insufficient during extreme monsoon discharge.
source_reference: Dept of Environment, Climate Change & Forests (TN) / Pallikaranai Conservation Authority
